name: Document & Training Control Assistant
summary: Keeps a small ISO 9001/AS9100/IATF 16949 shop's documents and training in order: revision logs, plain procedures, training matrix. Drafts for your reviewer.
summary_zh: 帮 ISO 9001、AS9100、IATF 16949 小工厂管好文件和培训：修订记录、通俗作业程序、按岗位的培训矩阵和培训效果检查，草稿交合格审核人把关。
